local_verification.source: schema/structure probe on this PC, 2026-10-27 (names, counts, column/key names only; message bodies, URLs, titles and credentials not read)
local_verification.agent_root: ~/.gemini/antigravity (NOT ~/.antigravity). ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md and ~/.gemini/antigravity-browser-profile also exist. A stray '~/..gemini/antigravity' (double dot) folder was seen as well

layout.conversations/: one SQLite file per conversation: <uuid>.db (+ -wal/-shm for active ones). 508 dbs, 2.9GB on this PC; size min 48KB / median 1.6MB / max 82MB
layout.conversation_summaries.db: 34MB index of all conversations incl. FTS5 full-text index (title, user_body, agent_body) - may allow search of conversation text even when a per-conversation db is missing
layout.brain/<uuid>/: per-conversation workspace: .system_generated/{logs,messages,steps,subagents}, .user_uploaded/, scratch/, plus generated *.md artifacts each with a *.md.metadata.json; 507 conversation dirs + tempmediaStorage
layout.scratch/: agent working files (py/png/txt/csv/json/html/xlsx/md; 1,794 files, 692MB) - contains work products, treat as user data
layout.mcp/<server>/: cache of MCP tool schemas (<tool>.json) per configured MCP server -> inventory of MCP servers/tools the agent was given (includes older/renamed copies)
layout.annotations/*.pbtxt: 262 small protobuf-text files named by conversation uuid
layout.code_tracker/{active,history}: snapshots of edited files (active/no_repo had 39 files)
layout.cache/marketplaces/, builtin/skills/, bi: marketplace cache, built-in skills, helper binaries

conversation_db_schema.note: payloads are BLOBs (probably protobuf); decoding was not attempted

plain_text_transcripts.brain/<uuid>/.system_generated/logs/tran: keys: content, created_at, source, status, step_index, type, tool_calls[].{name,args.*}, truncated_fields, token counters (input/output/cache_read)
plain_text_transcripts.brain/<uuid>/.system_generated/messages/: keys: id, sender, recipient, priority, content, timestamp, renderDetails.messageTitle, sourceMetadata.tool.{conversationId,stepIndex,toolCall.{id,name,argumentsJson}} (agent-to-agent messages)

ide_state.%APPDATA%\\Antigravity\\User\\globalStor: 0.4MB, ItemTable only (241 rows). AI-related key names: antigravity.notification.<uuid> (many), antigravity.profileUrl, antigravityAuthStatus (sensitive), antigravityAnalytics.* , antigravityChangelog/*, antigravity.agentViewContainerId.state.hidden. Conversations are NOT here

forensic_notes: Highest-value sources: conversations/<uuid>.db (steps) and conversation_summaries.db (index + FTS text); brain/<uuid>/.system_generated/logs/transcript*.jsonl is plain text and much easier to parse
Evidence is spread over three roots: ~/.gemini/antigravity (agent), %APPDATA%\Antigravity (IDE), ~/.antigravity(-ide) (extensions/argv)
~/.gemini also holds an OAuth token file and an auth status key: existence/mtime only, never values
